programs.description: From pursuing his career as a singer to marrying the love of his life, a boy belonging to a quaint village goes against great odds to achieve excellence and earn fame as Shahir Sable.
Two friends cross paths after a long time and decide to get drunk together. In their drunken stupor, they plan to kill each other's wives but face hilarious challenges in their quest.
In the village of Dhandalgaon, bitter rivals Dhandle Patil and Dhandalkar vie for supremacy. Their enmity, fueled by instigators, consumes the villagers' attention.
Friends Mane, Sathe and Kale decide to go on a road trip to Lonavla, where they meet a beautiful girl called Riya. Seeing Kale pursue her, the other two also join in, spoiling his plans.
Three troublesome college students always run into trouble and are belittled by their parents. However, when they come across a teenager who is being trafficked, they decide to rescue her.
A foreign-educated mill heir faces a series of misfortunes after his atheistic attitude clashes with everyone else's religious belief in Lord Ganesha.
Bhakti and Vakratund are a childless couple. When Bhakti learns that Vakratund's parents were unable to fulfil their promise to Lord Ganesha, they set off to Ganpatipule to fulfil the vow.
